column1: # REQ-033 annealed K-Maxwell vs batch size. SHA 365c392d, node wox8gkw (8xH100), venv019 torch 2.10.0+cu128.
# 12 arms = batch{0.25x,0.5x,2x} x kernel{A single-EMA muon mu0.95, B bimaxwell_muon record, C annealed_weights_muon shipped decays, D annealed_weights_muon batch-rescaled decays}.
# 2250-step continuations from a shared step-1000 state (eos_shared_base = bimaxwell switch_step:1000 = plain Muon through 1000). Base val@1000 = 3.65169.
# seed 0, n=1 per cell. lr 0.025 wd 0.05 mu 0.95 fixed across all arms; cool_down cooldown_frac 0.7; start 1000 -> stop 3250; checkpoint 3250 only; dense val [3000,3250]/10 + coarse /125.
# 1x row deliberately omitted (existing n=8 1x full-runs = out-of-band context only, never differenced).
# NB torch.compile mbs<64 NaN bug: the first pass NaN'd every arm within 10 steps of the fork. Root-caused to a compile shape bug at
#   microbatch_sequences<64 (verified: 1x batch @mbs16/32 also NaN; mbs=64 stable; eager fixes it). 0.25x/0.5x (mbs 16/32) run EAGER
#   (TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1, identical math), 2x (mbs 64) runs compiled. Column 'engine' records which. Within-batch contrast is unaffected.
# NOTE absolute loss is NOT comparable across batch sizes (2x sees 8x the tokens of 0.25x): 0.25x~3.45, 0.5x~3.35, 2x~3.21. Only the within-batch contrast below is meaningful.
